markets.title: What states will redistrict before the 2028 Congressional elections?
markets.rules_primary: If the Mississippi legislature has adopted new, qualifying congressional district maps after Issuance and before Nov 7, 2028 (ET), then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
These maps must be:
Formally adopted and enacted into law by the appropriate legislative or redistricting authority; AND
Not enjoined, vacated, stayed, or struck down in full by any court with jurisdiction over congressional redistricting in Mississippi as of the Expiration Date; AND
In effect for use in the first scheduled federal election after its adoption

For clarity:
Maps that are temporarily stayed pending appeal but later upheld will resolve to YES if they are ultimately in effect by the Expiration Date
Maps that are completely redrawn by a court or special master will resolve to NO
Maps that are withdrawn by the Legislature before implementation will resolve to NO
If no new maps are adopted by Nov 7, 2028, the market will resolve to NO
